🎥🎬: Two and a Half Men (2003–2015)

Charlie Harper is a wealthy, carefree jingle writer living a bachelor lifestyle in Malibu. His world changes when his divorced brother Alan and Alan’s young son Jake move into his beach house, turning Charlie’s easygoing life into a chaotic family arrangement.

While Charlie tries to maintain his partying and dating lifestyle, Alan struggles with his divorce and raising Jake. The three constantly clash with their very different personalities, while their mother Evelyn, housekeeper Berta, and the women in their lives add even more chaos.

source_details.synopsis: Two and a Half Men is an American television sitcom, created by Chuck Lorre and Lee Aronsohn, that aired for 12 seasons on CBS from September 22, 2003, to February 19, 2015. The series originally starred Charlie Sheen as Charlie Harper, a hedonistic jingle writer, alongside Jon Cryer as his uptight brother Alan, and Angus T. Jones as Alan's son Jake. Supporting roles were played by Holland Taylor, Marin Hinkle, Conchata Ferrell, and Melanie Lynskey. In February 2011, CBS halted production for the rest of the eighth season after Sheen entered drug rehabilitation and made disparaging comments about Lorre.
